name.en: Fio Puro Navy A-Line Midi Dress in Cotton with a Smart Casual Fit, Sleeveless Cut and Side Pockets
name.pt-BR: Vestido midi evasê Fio Puro marinho de algodão, sem manga, social leve, com bolsos laterais e saia que abre no passo

description.en: A cotton A-line midi with a smart casual neckline and pockets set into the side seams. It dresses up with a heel and down with a sandal.
description.pt-BR: Midi evasê de algodão, social leve, com bolsos nas laterais. Sobe o tom com salto e desce com sandália.
